changes: p1: roles reduced to 'commentator' only, since the text is a vyākhyā on the Candrāloka.
p1: dropped 'upākhya' from titles. It is not a title: it marks 'Pāyaṃguḍa' as a family name. The commentator's personal name is not given, so confidence is lowered to medium.
Date: weekday 'roja 1' rendered as Sunday; pakṣa normalized to śukla.

notes: The catalogue gives 'Pāyaṃguḍopākhya' as the scribe, but this is wrong. The colophon says 'pāyaṃguḍopākhya-viracite ... vyākhyāne', which names the commentator. 'Pāyaṃguḍa' is a family name, presumably Vaidyanātha Pāyaguṇḍe, known as a commentator on the Candrāloka. The colophon gives only the family name, not his personal name. 'ramādhipa' is probably a corrupt form of the commentary's title, likely Ramā. The colophon names no scribe. 'graṃthasaṃkhyā 2000' is the extent of the text, not a date. The era is unstated; VS is assumed from 'samvat' with 'miti/roja', which gives 1790 CE.
